title: Trans-CNN predicts stroke recurrence from vessel wall MRI
summary: ResNet50 and DenseNet169 feature extractors with Transformer attention (Trans-CNN) on culprit plaque images from 363 patients reached test AUC 0.912 (95% CI 0.839-0.969), accuracy 0.858 and sensitivity 0.880 in an external center of 109 patients. Training AUC was 0.951 in 254 patients. The test set had only 25 recurrences and the study is retrospective.
ai_technology: ResNet50 and DenseNet169 CNNs with Transformer attention ensemble (Trans-CNN) on HR-VWI
organization: First Affiliated Hospital of Xinxiang Medical University

evidence.tested: Independent external test set from a second center.
evidence.ai_role: Predicts stroke recurrence from plaque imaging

source_review.scope: Abstract and Europe PMC full-text Methods/Results excerpts read. Publisher version not otherwise accessed. Author affiliations from OpenAlex metadata.
